'''Ebrahi''' was the son of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nehanna]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. When [[Gender/Legends|his]] mother mysteriously disappeared, Ebrahi was too young to take the throne, so [[Credi Solfinn]] ruled in his place.<ref name="Strongholds" />
